in_arabic.name: نضر

in_urdu.name: نضر
in_urdu.meaning: نذر کا مطلب حسن اور جمال میں اضافہ ہے

in_english.name: Nadr
in_english.meaning: Nadr means increase in beauty and goodness
in_english.long_meaning: Nadr is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning increase in beauty and goodness. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Yunus: ﴿وننزلنا عليك الكتاب تبيانا لكل شيء ورحمة وبشرى للنصرين﴾, where Nadr signifies an increase in good and growth. Historically, this name has been used in Islamic tradition to denote good qualities and praiseworthy characteristics. The name Nadr is derived from the Arabic root 'n-d-r' which conveys the idea of growth, increase, and beauty
